import numpy as np


def cashflows(perf, terms):
    perf = np.asarray(perf, dtype=float)
    n_paths = perf.shape[0]
    n_dates = perf.shape[1]
    cash = np.zeros((n_paths, n_dates), dtype=float)
    notional = float(terms["notional"])
    final_index = int(terms["final_index"])
    if perf.shape[2] == 1:
        worst = perf[:, :, 0]
    else:
        worst = np.min(perf, axis=2)
    autocall = terms["autocall"]
    coupon = terms["coupon"]
    downside = terms["downside"]
    upside = terms["upside"]
    alive = np.ones(n_paths, dtype=bool)
    missed = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=float)
    for k in range(n_dates):
        if not np.any(alive):
            break
        level_k = worst[:, k]
        coupon_due = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=float)
        if coupon is not None:
            amounts = coupon["amounts"]
            if amounts[k] is not None:
                amount = float(amounts[k])
                barrier = float(coupon["barrier"])
                meets = level_k >= barrier
                if bool(coupon["memory"]):
                    pays = alive & meets
                    coupon_due[pays] = amount + missed[pays]
                    missed[pays] = 0.0
                    missed[alive & ~meets] += amount
                else:
                    coupon_due[alive & meets] = amount
        called = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=bool)
        if autocall is not None and k != final_index:
            call_amounts = autocall["call_amounts"]
            if call_amounts[k] is not None:
                trigger = float(autocall["trigger"])
                called = alive & (level_k >= trigger)
                if np.any(called):
                    cash[called, k] += float(call_amounts[k]) + coupon_due[called]
                    alive[called] = False
        if np.any(alive & ~called) and np.any(coupon_due != 0.0):
            pay_coupon = alive & (coupon_due != 0.0)
            if k != final_index:
                cash[pay_coupon, k] += coupon_due[pay_coupon]
        if k == final_index:
            remaining = alive
            if np.any(remaining):
                r = level_k[remaining]
                payoff = np.empty_like(r)
                up = r > 1.0
                if np.any(up):
                    if upside is not None:
                        leverage = float(upside["leverage"])
                        ret = leverage * (r[up] - 1.0)
                        cap = upside["cap"]
                        if cap is not None:
                            ret = np.minimum(ret, float(cap))
                        payoff[up] = notional * (1.0 + ret)
                    else:
                        payoff[up] = notional * r[up]
                if np.any(~up):
                    gearing = float(downside["gearing"])
                    payoff[~up] = notional * (1.0 + gearing * (r[~up] - 1.0))
                payoff = np.maximum(payoff, 0.0)
                cash[remaining, k] += payoff + coupon_due[remaining]
                alive[remaining] = False
    return cash
